title: Diamond transports in quadratic-form and distorted optimal transport
summary: The diamond transport is generated by the uniform law on a diamond-shaped copula support. Since a classical optimal transport (OT) objective is affine in the coupling, this transport cannot be the unique minimizer in the classical setting. We study a broader family of transports, called diamond-type transports, in non-classical settings such as quadratic-form optimal transport (QOT) and distorted optimal transport (DOT), which are generally nonconvex.
